description: Get a fresh `hostHandoffUrl` for a bill you created, so the host can finish setup on their phone. Only the key that created the bill can do this. Never ask for or accept a Venmo or Zelle handle. The host adds it on their phone through the handoff link. Keep `assistantKey` inside tool calls and never show it to the user. Give the user `hostHandoffUrl`.

assistantKey.description: The assistantKey returned when you created or joined this bill. Pass it on every later call for this bill.

bill.description: A Split the Tab bill link (https://…/b/<id>) or the bill id.

name: get_host_handoff_link
title: Get a host setup link
